rules.title: Los Angeles Just Cause Ordinance (JCO) – just cause required to terminate tenancy
rules.requirement: Landlords of covered non-RSO rental units may terminate a tenancy only for an enumerated at-fault reason (e.g., nonpayment, uncured lease violation, nuisance, illegal use, refusal to renew, denial of access, unapproved subtenant) or an enumerated no-fault reason (e.g., owner/family move-in, resident manager, demolition/withdrawal, government order, HUD sale, residential hotel conversion, conversion to affordable housing).
rules.coverage_conditions: Most residential properties in the City of Los Angeles not regulated by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), including single-family dwellings and buildings newer than October 1, 1978; applies once the tenant has lived in the unit at least six months or the original lease has expired, whichever comes first.
rules.exemptions: Transient hotels, licensed care facilities, fraternity/sorority houses, owner's roommate, cooperatives in certain circumstances, some non-profit homeless facilities or short-term substance abuse treatment centers, some HACLA- or government-owned properties; RSO units are covered by the RSO instead.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to units not regulated by the City's RSO; tenancy must have lasted at least six months or the original lease must have expired; owner's-roommate and certain facility-type exceptions.

rules.citation: City of Los Angeles Just Cause Ordinance (JCO)
rules.quoted_span: It prohibits terminations of tenancies without just cause and requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.

rules.title: Los Angeles JCO – relocation assistance for no-fault evictions
rules.requirement: When a landlord terminates a JCO-covered tenancy for a no-fault reason, the landlord must pay the tenant relocation assistance; tenants evicted for at-fault reasons are not entitled to it.
rules.coverage_conditions: JCO-covered rental units (non-RSO units in the City of Los Angeles) where the tenancy is terminated for a no-fault reason.
rules.exemptions: At-fault evictions; JCO exceptions (transient hotels, licensed care facilities, owner's roommate, etc.).

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to no-fault terminations of JCO-covered (non-RSO) tenancies meeting the six-month/lease-expiration threshold.

rules.quoted_span: It prohibits terminations of tenancies without just cause and requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.

rules.title: Los Angeles Notice of Right to Counsel posting and service
rules.requirement: Landlords must post a Notice of Right to Counsel in a conspicuous common area of the building and provide it to the tenant at the start of the tenancy and whenever an eviction notice is served.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental buildings in the City of Los Angeles.
rules.citation: City of Los Angeles Right to Counsel notice requirement (LAHD)
rules.quoted_span: in a conspicuous common area of the residential building where the tenant resides. This notice is also to be provided to the tenant at the beginning of the tenancy and anytime an eviction notice is served.
rules.conflict_note: Ordinance citation not given on page.

rules.title: Los Angeles Notice of Renters' Protections
rules.requirement: All residential landlords must give a Notice of Renters' Protections to tenants who begin or renew a tenancy on or after January 27, 2023, and post it in an accessible common area.
rules.coverage_conditions: All residential rental properties in the City of Los Angeles; tenancies beginning or renewing on or after January 27, 2023.
rules.citation: City of Los Angeles Notice of Renters' Protections requirement (LAHD)
rules.quoted_span: All landlords of residential properties must provide a Notice of Renters’ Protections to tenants who begin or renew their tenancy on or after January 27, 2023.

rules.title: Los Angeles nonpayment eviction threshold (Fair Market Rent)
rules.requirement: Landlords may not evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent unless the amount owed exceeds one month's Fair Market Rent for the unit's bedroom size.
rules.key_value: Arrears must exceed one month's HUD Fair Market Rent for unit size
rules.coverage_conditions: All RSO and JCO rental units in the City of Los Angeles.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies to units covered by the RSO or JCO.

rules.citation: City of Los Angeles nonpayment eviction threshold (applies to RSO & JCO units)
rules.quoted_span: Effective March 27, 2023, landlords may not evict a tenant who falls behind in rent unless the tenant owes an amount higher than the Fair Market Rent (FMR).
rules.conflict_note: Ordinance citation not given on page.

rules.title: Los Angeles eviction notice filing with LAHD
rules.requirement: All eviction notices served on tenants in the City of Los Angeles must be filed with LAHD within three business days of service.
rules.coverage_conditions: All JCO and RSO rental properties in the City of Los Angeles.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies to units covered by the RSO or JCO.

rules.citation: City of Los Angeles eviction notice filing requirement (LAHD)
rules.quoted_span: All eviction notices issued to tenants in the City of Los Angeles must be filed with LAHD within three (3) business days of service on the tenant.

rules.title: California Tenant Protection Act (AB 1482) annual rent cap
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases for covered units are limited to 5% plus the regional change in cost of living, or 10%, whichever is lower.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential units in California older than 15 years (rolling) not subject to stricter local rent control (e.g., LA RSO).
rules.exemptions: Units built within the last 15 years (rolling); deed- or regulatory-restricted affordable units; certain dormitories; two-unit owner-occupied properties; single-family homes and condos not owned by a REIT, corporation, or LLC with a corporate member where written exemption notice was given; units subject to the City's RSO.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Single-family/condo exemption requires written notice to tenant under Civ. Code 1947.12(d)(5)(B)(i); excludes deed-restricted affordable units and certain dormitories.
